thread.title: Buy the ‘Apple of Oil’ and Three Other E&P Energy Stocks

author: Teresa Rivas
title: Buy the ‘Apple of Oil’ and Three Other E&P Energy Stocks
text:
By Teresa Rivas July 24, 2018 2:22 p.m. ET While energy has rebounded a bit with higher energy prices, with the Energy Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLE) up 4.4% year to date, that's a recent development: The sector languished for years after oil prices collapsed in 2014.
Illustration: Ed Schipul The situation got so bad that oil's share of the S&P 500 dropped to its lowest level since 1998, when crude was under $10 a barrel, but after years of brutal punishment, energy, and explorations and production specifically, has "never been in better shape," writes Mizuho analyst Paul Sankey.
Sankey initiated coverage on a number of global oil and gas companies on Tuesday, writing that from a resource opportunity, technological, and management and strategy standpoint, the industry is much stronger after surviving the recent downturn.
His Buy-rated stocks are Pioneer Natural Resources (PXD), Anadarko Petroleum (APC), EOG Resources (EOG), Noble Energy (NBL), while he has Neutral ratings on Marathon Oil (MRO), Hess (HES), Devon Energy (DVN), and Apache (APA). Murphy Oil (MUR) is his only Underperform-rated name.
As for EOG specifically, Sankey is especially enthusiastic. He has a $173 price target on the shares, which he calls the Apple (AAPL) of oil, writing that EOG has been at the vanguard of unconventional oil development and has a history of emphasizing innovation and technology (as well as capital discipline). He sees the company as "a leader in the E&P Renaissance. We find the company to have the strongest culture, technology, and marginal results improvement in US E&P...[and] the potential for rapidly rising cash return is excellent."
EOG is up 2.2% to $125.55 in recent trading, while XLE is up 1.1% to $75.35 and the e SPDR S&P Oil & Gas Exploration & Production ETF (XOP) is up 0.8% to $42.65.
